title: UFOs over nuclear ICBMs as a message, not over data centers
summary: Unnamed guest tells of UFOs over nuclear ICBMs as a message, not over data centers, about an unknown time at nuclear ICBM sites, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: with nuclear ICBMs and so on so forth you know we can see them over the nuclear uh ICBMs and so that might be a message

related.note: Same subject, UFOs over nuclear ICBMs, but the core claim is that they are sending a message, unlike the waiting-for-humanity explanation.

plain: An unnamed researcher, a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that UFOs are seen over nuclear ICBMs, the long-range missiles that carry nuclear warheads. The guest suggests this might be a message, and in an episode about artificial intelligence the contrast is that they appear over nuclear weapons rather than over data centers, which would say something about what they care about.
